method.fixture: Actual buildChinaPricingGeneration from china-pricing-worker-fixture with 24 ready synthetic combustion offers, sourcePrice 60000 + i * 100 CNY, and all 33 prepared city keys including the unquoted key
method.statistic: p50UpperMs = sorted measured request durations after discarding the first request, element index 10 of 20; this is the upper middle observation, not the mean of the two middle observations
method.clock: performance.now(), timed request only, excluding forced GC and fixture preparation
method.processes: Separate fresh Node processes for exact baseline reader/helper source and patched reader/helper source; same local workspace and fixture
method.retainedMode: All 63 returned request objects remain strongly retained through the measurement
method.releasedMode: No returned request object retained; setImmediate job boundary, global.gc(), another setImmediate boundary before every timed request
method.instrumentation: Direct wrappers count city SQL reads, gunzip and city JSON parse work without retaining return objects
method.limitation: Local synthetic reader workload; does not measure server HTTP/SSR/browser latency or establish frozen baseline acceptance

validation.peerReview: approved; exact existing composite city_prices index used for 24-ID and 48-ID batch queries with 33 cities
